title: A Desert Cave Hid a Library for 900 Years — Silk Road EP1 | China Travel Expert
description:
On the old Silk Road, a single desert cave kept a whole library hidden for about 900 years.

Follow the route west to Dunhuang, in Gansu, where monks carved 492 caves into a cliff face — the Mogao Grottoes. One of them, Cave 17, was walled off and plastered over around 1000 AD and forgotten, until the caretaker Wang Yuanlu opened it on 25 June 1900. Inside were more than 50,000 manuscripts written in over twenty languages: Buddhist sutras, contracts, songs and letters spanning a thousand years of Silk Road life.

🧭 Expert Tip: Mogao caps daily visitors with timed tickets — book several days ahead, especially in summer and holidays, or you may not get in.

一座沙漠石窟，藏经洞封存了九百年——丝路的第一站。
